system.name: JENGA
system.one_liner: a two-level memory allocation framework for heterogeneous LLM layer embeddings that reduces fragmentation and enables layer-specific caching, built on vLLM

components.name: request
components.role: incoming request that enters the serving system

components.name: Scheduler
components.role: receives requests and coordinates work with the Workers and the memory manager

components.name: Workers
components.role: execute the request using memory allocated by Jenga's Memory Manager

components.name: LCM allocator
components.role: first-level allocator using the least common multiple of embedding sizes to allocate pages compatible across all layer types

components.name: Prefix-subset evictor
components.role: coordinates eviction among different layer types at the first level

components.name: LCM page
components.role: compatible-size page unit produced by the LCM allocator

components.name: self-attn allocator
components.role: second-level allocator specialized for self-attention layer page sizes

components.name: self-attn evictor
components.role: second-level evictor customizing the eviction strategy for self-attention layers

components.name: mamba allocator
components.role: second-level allocator specialized for mamba layer page sizes

components.name: mamba evictor
components.role: second-level evictor customizing the eviction strategy for mamba layers

summary: JENGA is a two-level memory allocation framework for LLM inference that handles heterogeneous per-layer embedding sizes (e.g., self-attention vs. Mamba) to reduce fragmentation and support layer-specific caching, implemented on top of vLLM. Figure 5 shows a request flowing from the Scheduler to Workers, coordinated with Jenga's Memory Manager (dashed box). Inside, a shared first-level LCM allocator and Prefix-subset evictor produce LCM pages (using the least common multiple of embedding sizes for compatibility across layer types); these feed two parallel second-level paths — a green self-attention allocator/evictor and an orange mamba allocator/evictor — each of which specializes the compatible pages into 'Customized pages for the request' shown at the bottom, one colored set per layer type.
summary_zh: 图5展示JENGA两级内存管理：调度器分发请求，内部由共享LCM分配器/驱逐器生成兼容页，再由自注意力与Mamba各自的二级分配器/驱逐器定制化，底部展示按类型区分的最终页面。
